scores_provenance.param_source: H8 protocol (pre-registered); front end {'grid': 6, 'r': 2, 'colour_edges': True, 'per_channel': True, 'half_m': 1.1}; scripts/recog_v2_run.py
scores_provenance.dino: facebookresearch/dinov2 dinov2_vits14 (torch hub, Apache-2.0), patch-max as v1

definition: v1 H4 definition: Mann-Whitney AUROC, target probes vs swapped-decoy probes per azimuth bin, pooled over distance (3, 6, 12 m), 2 random suns, 2 jitter reps and 10 layouts; 95% CI = percentile bootstrap over layouts (2000); catchment = consecutive 15-deg bins from 0 with AUROC >= 0.75.

cost.notes: MB: 20,000 1-bit KC->MBON weights whatever the number of views (PN->KC wiring regenerated from seed). Front end: fixed filters, 0 learned bytes; n_in 288. nn_front stores uint16 ranks per view. pixels uint8 32x32/view, pixels_crop uint8 24x24/view, colour uint16 512 bins/view, DINO fp16 384-d/view (+ 22.06 M fp32 model weights, 88 MB, not counted here).
cost.ms_note: one 48x48 crop vs the 31-view ms memory, M4, numpy CPU, excl. rendering/cropping
